org.name: Over the Influence Recovery
org.tagline: You don't have to do it alone.
org.headline: Empowering moms in recovery to stop relapsing and start thriving.
org.mission: Over the Influence Recovery is a non-profit organization that supports mothers in recovery to live over the influence of drugs, shame, and regret and build a life they desire, create and love for themselves and their children. We empower women to stop relapsing, align their actions with their values, and join a fun and healthy community of mothers who thrive in recovery.

programs.name: T.H.R.I.V.E.
programs.summary: A six-month Peer Recovery Coaching program for women recovering from substance use disorder.
details: Weekly one-on-one sessions with an empowering recovery coach who helps you set and achieve your goals

details: Feel less lonely, isolated, or judged

programs.name: Individual Coaching (online or in person)

phones.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
phones.description: Call or text for any emotional crisis, thoughts of suicide, or substance use crisis. Free and confidential.

phones.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
phones.description: Free, confidential treatment referral and information service for individuals and families facing substance use or mental health disorders.

phones.name: San Diego Access & Crisis Line
phones.description: Immediate support from a counselor on crisis intervention, suicide prevention, mental health referrals, and alcohol and drug support services in San Diego County. TDD/TTY 711.

phones.name: Crisis Text Line
phones.description: Text with a trained crisis counselor.

phones.name: Never Use Alone (overdose prevention line)
phones.description: If you or someone you love is going to use, don't use alone. An operator stays on the line and sends help if you stop responding. No judgment.

phones.name: Alcoholics Anonymous, San Diego Central Office
phones.description: Talk to a sober member and find local meetings. Office: 7075 Mission Gorge Rd, Suite B, San Diego.

phones.name: Narcotics Anonymous, San Diego helpline
phones.description: Speak with a recovering addict and find local NA meetings.

phones.name: Women for Sobriety
phones.description: Peer support program for women overcoming substance use disorders. Online and in-person meetings.

phones.name: National Maternal Mental Health Hotline
phones.description: Free, confidential support before, during, and after pregnancy. Call or text.

phones.name: Postpartum Support International HelpLine
phones.hours: Messages returned 8 AM–11 PM ET, every day (not a crisis line)
phones.description: Support and local resources for perinatal mood and anxiety disorders.

phones.name: NAMI HelpLine
phones.description: Information, resource referrals, and support for people living with a mental health condition and their families. Not a crisis line.

phones.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
phones.description: Confidential support, safety planning, and local resources. Call, or text START to 88788.

phones.name: Poison Control
phones.description: Free, expert help with poisoning or an overdose that is not yet an emergency. If someone is unresponsive or not breathing, call 911.

phones.name: 2-1-1 San Diego
phones.description: Free, confidential connection to community, health, and disaster resources: food, housing, childcare, health coverage, and more.

testimonials.name: Belinda
testimonials.quote: I've been through countless programs, but OTI has helped me more than all the others combined. Here, I finally feel worth, support, and real growth. I'm so grateful for my peer coach and the close-knit community that has changed my life.
